text:
Anya Ops: Heads-up — scheduling PrairiePay Dedicated rollout for tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need quick approvals for change window + model pin. Tenant: prairie-pay-prod, slice: slice-07.
Anya Ops: Model pin: `rw-13b-v1.4.2-quant` (primary), fallback `rw-13b-v1.3.8`. Rollout plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% (30m ramps).
Anya Ops: Rollback triggers: error rate > 3% above baseline OR p95 latency > 2x baseline for two consecutive windows. Post-deploy smoke tests + synthetic prompt evals. Release notes: https://redwood-internal/releases/PRP-20260311 (contains perf numbers & regen tests).
Matt P: ok from eng — can we pin worker kernel to 2.1.7 for this slice? last time kernel mismatch caused small perf regressions.
Anya Ops: yes pin `kernel=2.1.7` in the slice config. I'll include a snippet in deploy.
Evan-SRE: please include canary metrics in dashboard and hook alert for rollback threshold. Also add a higher-severity page if canary fails during 02:00-04:00 UTC.
Anya Ops: will do. dashboard: /dashboards/prairiepay/slice-07-canary. Alert config: `alerts: {canary_error_rate: 3%, p95_latency_multiplier: 2.0}`
Jenna (CS): CS notified customer success lead (PrairiePay SRE) and on-call for 02:00-05:00 window. Customer asked for notification at start of canary and full cutover.
Sam Eng: approving change window and model pin from my side. Confirming we keep canary traffic routed by tenant header and not by region?
Anya Ops: correct — header-based routing for deterministic split, region fallback still enabled as graceful degradation.
Evan-SRE: quick question — what’s the plan if we hit transient token errors that look like infrastructure flakiness? rollback or pause?
Anya Ops: pause at 5% and investigate. If persistent across 2 consecutive checks we will roll back to `rw-13b-v1.3.8`. We’ll also open infra incident if it looks infra-related.
Matt P: +1 — recommend we also pre-warm KV cache for the canary nodes: `./scripts/prewarm_kv.sh --tenant prairie-pay-prod --slice slice-07`
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @Anya Ops: canary start 2026-03-11T02:05:00Z -> canary step1 (5%). Full plan: 5% @02:05, 25% @02:35, 100% @03:05. Pin config: `model=rw-13b-v1.4.2-quant, kernel=2.1.7, fallback=rw-13b-v1.3.8`
deploy-bot: Preflight checks: config validation OK, infra capacity OK, canary quota OK.
Jenna (CS): noted — telling customer: "Canary starts 02:05 UTC, we'll notify at canary start and full cutover. We'll escalate immediately on regressions."
Sam Eng: approved. Please make sure the runbook link is included in the page: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/dedicated-rollout
Anya Ops: Adding runbook to alert and the deployment description. final ask: @Evan-SRE / @Matt P — anything blocking from SRE/ENG?
Evan-SRE: nothing blocking, I’ll be monitoring.
Matt P: none here. good to go from eng.
Anya Ops: thanks. scheduling now and will post postmortem template if there’s any deviation. :thumbsup:
